reference.Description: Referencing of the derivation (bipolar: adjacent contacts named in the channel label)

roi.Description: Region of interest assigned by the authors (anatomy xlsx column 'roi'), e.g. dlPFC, vmPFC, lOFC, aINS (definitions: Combrisson et al. 2024, eLife 12:RP92938, doi:10.7554/eLife.92938, Methods 'Anatomical labeling')

Levels.aINS: anterior insula (Destrieux: short insular gyri, anterior circular insular sulcus, anterior part of the superior circular insular sulcus)
Levels.vmPFC: ventromedial prefrontal cortex (MarsAtlas PFCvm, OFCv, OFCvm)
